steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Aosta, are we really joining this Rhodes Island organization?

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: That's right, Broca. I think it's our best option.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: There's   other places we could go.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: I know you aren't a fan of this idea, Broca, but, honestly, this is our best option.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Oh, don't give me that look  , Broca.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: If things don't go our way, all we gotta do is split.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Hah... I don't think it's that simple, but he has a point.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: So how about it, Broca? Are you on board?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...I'll give it a try.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: You're finally awake.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Where are we...?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: The forest. Our team was attacked by a pack of beasts, and the two of us fell off the cliff. Remember now?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Hmph, you're not very cute, are you?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Well, I still gotta thank you. If it wasn't for you, I might've   died there on the spot.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Don't mention it.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Aghhhhhhhh! Fine, okay! I'm sorry I picked that bone with you yesterday. I shouldn't have said that.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I'm a little testy  , you see. I don't like it when I hear someone badmouthing Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: But you're new here. It's not your fault you don't know what we're like just yet. Yato really tore me a new one last night. Don't take it personally, okay?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: No, I was at fault myself.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Eh, c'mon. I did you wrong, and I'll own up to that.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Anyway, let's put it behind us. That fine with you?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Well, that's a weight off my shoulders. It's been bothering me all day.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Where's everyone else?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: No idea. With their skills, I'm sure they can hold their own.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: We should look for them, then... Ugh.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Hold up, bro. You shouldn't move around yet, what with how hurt you are.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: 'Bro?'

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Oh, that's just what I call everyone. It's more intimate. You don't have a problem with that, do you?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Call me whatever you want.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Alright, that settles it. Let's rest up here for the time being. We'll get moving once you heal up a bit.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Eh, don't worry. Yato's there with them. She's one of the most experienced operators we have. Nothing's gonna happen to them. Let's take care of ourselves.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Well, you lie down here a bit more. I'll take a look around.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You know how loyal I am! Why are you abandoning me, Boss?!
It's because you're loyal  , Broca.
All that loyalty, isn't it natural you'd die for me?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Yo, bro. Broca. I'm back.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I took a stroll around. This forest is huge. We gotta be a bit more careful.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: My wound's starting to get better. Let's move.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: You sure you don't want to rest a little more?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'm good.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Right on, let's get moving, then. I have a decent idea of which way we came from.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Hey, bro, I've been wondering. What's with that saw on the back of your drill?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I don't see you using it much when you fight.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I use this when I do retrofitting work. It's for sawing wood, among other things.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Sawing wood? So you used to be a lumberjack or something?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: No, I wasn't. I just like crafting sometimes.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Heh, I didn't expect you to be the crafty kind.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: It's nothing that amazing.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Well, bro, I just noticed there's one more thing I'm wrong about you. When we left for this mission, I thought you were the type to keep to himself. I didn't know you could be so talkative.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: You should talk more. Try to express yourself if you don't want people to get the wrong idea. I mean, yesterday was the perfect example.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I actually mean it, though.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: You mean you don't trust Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Man, that's what I was talking about. You just got here, makes sense that you'd be a little iffy on the place.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Really, though, hear me out on this one. You really shouldn't talk like that. The first thing you said was 'I don't trust Rhodes Island.' What kind of impression do you think that gives the rest of us?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I don't...

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Eh, stop right there, bro. I'm not trying to say you're hurting anyone's feelings or to tell you to shape up or anything. It's just, well, how should I say   this...?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: You see, I used to be a mercenary, and I've worked for organizations before, too. When I first got here, it was purely transactional. I was just here to make a living.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: They treat us well, and the food's not bad, but that's about it. If you'd asked me back then, I probably would've told you I don't believe in that good, charitable company bull crap.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I mean, all the big companies are basically the same. You feel the same way too, no?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: But anyway, I've been here for a while, and I can tell. Rhodes Island is different. This is something you need to learn yourself. Ain't nobody can teach you that.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: And yes, I trust Amiya, I trust the Doctor, and I trust Dr. Kal'tsit. They all won   me over.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I didn't snap because the way you were talking bugged me. I snapped because what you said was wrong. You know what I mean?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'm not sure...

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Eh, it's all good. I'm not telling you to figure it all out right now. What I'm trying to say is Rhodes Island isn't quite like what you think it is. You should try to trust in us a little more.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I don't remember helping out the village being part of our mission.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Huh? Oh, that? It's actually the Captain's call. If he thinks we can manage it, in most cases, we try to do something to help the locals out.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Why bring that up all of a sudden?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: No reason...

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Come on... Wait, bro.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Look.
Before the duo realize what has happened, the beasts that attacked the squad have already surrounded them.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Looks like we got   company.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I can still fight...

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Don't. You haven't healed up yet. I'll create an opening for you. Run away when you get the chance.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I can't leave you behind.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Hey, bro, you know why I apologized to you in the first place?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I wouldn't apologize even if Yato lectured me the whole night, but you shielded me when we got ambushed. That's when I knew you were a good guy.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Someone like you will come to like Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Anyway, I owe you this one.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Eh, bro, don't be so stubborn.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Relax. This is nothing. I ain't gonna die.
Broca simply stands there and lifts his weapon as though he didn't hear the operator's plea.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Eh, you really ain't cute at all.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I can let it slide though.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Alright, then. Stay close to me, bro. I got your back, and you got mine. We'll bust through these jackasses and make it out of here, together!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Alright.
Just before the two of them could attack, a yelp can be heard from amongst the beasts.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Huh? Is that...?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Are you two okay?!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Oh, there you are! We're fine!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hey, Broca, you don't look so good. Hurry. Sit down and let me take a look.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: That's Yato and the rest of the gang over there, right?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Yep, we've been looking for you two ever since you fell down there. It's such a relief to find you alive.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It looks like you're hanging in there okay. We can't let our guard down, though. Let's leave this place to the others and take Broca back first.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: No problem!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Huh? What was that?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: So how was your first field op, Broca?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: It was fine.

steps.name: Aosta
steps.text: Really? Great. I was worried you'd end up starting a fight. I guess I shouldn't have worried.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Yeah, I think... I can give this a try.
